EdTech Masterplan page 'Last Updated: 24 Apr 2026' (living page; earlier versions not available)

AI in education page 'Last Updated: 31 Jul 2026'; states MOE commitments (age-appropriate, purposeful) and that MOE's position guides AI use in schools; first publication date unknown; page text from cache is partial (position/governance subpages not read)
Developing students' AI literacy page 'Last Updated: 21 Sep 2026'; Four Learns approach; SLS self-paced modules
findings.evidence_quote_short: Learn about AI, Learn to use AI, Learn with AI

findings.claim: Parliamentary reply published 06 May 2026 (combined response, Minister): P1-3 no work requiring direct AI use; from P4 educational AI tools under teacher supervision; P4-6 only education-specific tools; national exams prohibit AI.
